note: All benchmark cost maths in this repo loads this file. Update it by committing a new dated snapshot, never by editing an old one.

jev.what: TypeSafe decision model, served as the classifier.dev 'fast' tier (model id jev-1.13.0)
jev.direct_api_note: Direct Jev needs a TypeSafe key. No key is present on Rajeev's machine, so every Jev measurement in this repo goes through the public classifier.dev endpoint and is reported as classifier.dev(fast).
jev.source: jev-tests README reference price at repo creation; classifier.dev/benchmark quotes about $0.005 per 1k items for calling Jev directly

classifier_dev.what: Public zero-shot classification HTTP API in front of Jev
classifier_dev.smart_note: smart = Jev, then a reasoning model (gemini-3.8-flash) re-asks only answers under 0.7 confidence

glm_5_3_flash.note: The jev-tests README reference figure at repo creation was $0.075 in / $0.25 out. Live OpenRouter pricing on the run date is $0.09 in / $0.30 out; this snapshot uses the live figure and every result records it.

adpi_semantic_extraction.what: The expensive downstream step Test 1 is trying to protect
adpi_semantic_extraction.note: ad-platform-intelligence runs semantic extraction/synthesis with a GLM-class model over cleaned documents; cost is measured there from OpenRouter usage, so the same per-token prices apply.
